mapper.insert: insert into chat_data_config ( chat_data_id, chat_id, data_snapshot_type, data_snapshot_id, data_filter_text, is_latest, created_by, created_time ) values ( #{chatDataId}, #{chatId}, #{dataSnapshotType}, #{dataSnapshotId}, #{dataFilterText}, #{isLatest}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime} )
mapper.select: select chat_data_id as chatDataId, chat_id as chatId, data_snapshot_type as dataSnapshotType, data_snapshot_id as dataSnapshotId, data_filter_text as dataFilterText, is_latest as isLatest, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime from chat_data_config where chat_id = #{chatId} and is_latest = 1 order by created_time desc limit 1
mapper.update: update chat_data_config set is_latest = 0 where chat_id = #{chatId} and is_latest = 1
